And he looked at that, he looked at the cut on those drawers, and he could see about where the spot was. He didn't know…

1.t: Cab shows Dizzy his scar in Nice
1.s: Years later in Nice Cab pulled down his pants to show Dizzy the scar, and they are friends now.
1.ch: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
1.q: Well, right after that, I saw them... It wasn't a week later. Dizzy passed where the bus was...

1.t: Why Cab hated trash on stage and Milt's missed solo
1.s: Cab hated paper on stage, and Milt explains his bowed solo Girl of My Dreams and how Cab blamed Dizzy for a spitball that landed beside them.

1.q: And he'd make these spitballs. We didn't mind, see. And nobody minded. But the thing was with Cab, he liked a perfect stage. He didn't like to see no paper because he's a dancer, and if you have a gum wrapper or if you have a piece of gum, a rubber band or a label... People would take...they're…

473.t: Defending Dizzy to Cab and Mills's manager; Charlie Barnet refuses him
473.s: Jones told Cab it was him throwing paper wads, but the manager insisted Diz be fired; Charlie Barnet refused to hire Diz as the man who cut Cab.
473.q: Duke and Cab. They were supposed to be incorporated, or something, you know. So I went in to talk to him, but I've got a job waiting, you know. I've got a job waiting, in case I don't like what's going on with Cab. You know, you heard so much stuff, about how he hollers at you and you know, stuff.
